static_traits.name: Grace Reynolds
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive group of friends and a close family, but has not yet discussed travel-related Anxiety with them
static_traits.medical_history: No similar problems have occurred before; has not yet received psychotherapy in the past; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression in conversation, good logic; highly cooperative, Positive attitude; able to engage in self-Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling overwhelmed and Anxiety due to being unable to travel, worrying that this is affecting my mental health.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling to better manage mental health due to indoor confinement and intensified Anxiety caused by travel restrictions.

core_beliefs: Being unable to travel will ruin my mental health
Without traveling, life will become boring and unfulfilling

special_situations.event: Travel restrictions implemented due to the COVID-19 pandemic
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot travel freely, my mental health will suffer, and life will become meaningless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Alleviating Anxiety through distraction and mindfulness practice
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may never be able to travel again; this will ruin my mental health

special_situations.event: Seeing others travel or talk about travel plans on social media
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others can travel but I cannot, it means I have missed important experiences in life
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing discussions of Anxiety with family and friends, bearing it alone; trying distraction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; my life is slipping away from me

special_situations.event: Being trapped indoors for a long time, unable to explore outdoors
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I stay indoors all the time, my life will remain boring and unfulfilling
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to fill time with other at-home activities to shift attention
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will always be trapped indoors, life is very boring

core_conflict.wish: Longing to explore freely, gaining fulfillment and vitality (through travel)
core_conflict.fear: Fears being restricted and trapped, life losing meaning and mental health being damaged
defense_goal: Maintaining surface stability by not discussing Anxiety with others
Suppressing the Anxiety experience through distraction and mindfulness

object_relations.object_representation: People who are free and traveling (making me feel excluded)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about discussing one's travel-related Anxiety with family or friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: They may not understand or take it seriously, so I need to handle my emotions myself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond briefly and politely, avoiding details; shift the topic to Learning or daily plans, emphasizing 'I can handle it myself', keeping some distance.

manifestations: Travel restrictions during the pandemic made it impossible to go out and explore, with the subjective experience of 'being trapped indoors'
Believing that without traveling, life is boring and unfulfilling

contact_model.definition: the individual restrains the urge to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, turning to do it to oneself instead -- i.e. the individual turns libidinal energy originally directed outward toward oneself
manifestations: Not expressing travel-related Anxiety to family and friends, choosing to bear it alone
When Anxiety strikes, turning to self-Repression, self-regulating through distraction or mindfulness

positive_force: Has a supportive group of friends and close family (potential support resources)
Positive attitude, willing to try strategies (distraction, mindfulness)
Has self-Reflection ability, able to adopt a more balanced perspective
negative_force: Catastrophizing and future-predicting thoughts, worrying about 'never being able to travel again'
Overgeneralization and social comparison (devaluing oneself when seeing others travel)
Avoiding communication with important others, bearing Anxiety alone
Long-term being stuck indoors disrupts physiological rhythms (sleep, diet) and affects studies

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent anxiety and repeated worries around being unable to travel
antecedent: Seeing others travel or talk about travel plans on social media
target_behavior.core_reason: Directly equating travel with mental health and life meaning, and catastrophically predicting a future of 'never traveling again'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncertainty and loss of control, trying to maintain psychological vigilance and control through worrying
target_behavior.consequence: Academic performance affected,Interpersonal tension,Sleep and eating disrupted

target_behavior.behavior: Not expressing travel-related Anxiety to family and friends
antecedent: When feeling Anxiety or being asked how one is doing
When considering whether to discuss Anxiety with family and friends
target_behavior.core_reason: Tending to handle emotions alone (not yet discussing travel Anxiety with the support system)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding exposing vulnerability, temporarily reducing external pressure and discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Support system unable to intervene, Anxiety persists and affects relationships
